reforms.description: The Canadian government extended the investment tax credit scheme, broadening its scope and increasing benefits to encourage investment in slower-growth regions.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By incentivizing investment in underdeveloped regions, the reform aims to stimulate economic activity and enhance productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The investment tax credit scheme was extended with increased benefits.
reforms.importance_rationale: The extension of the investment tax credit represents a significant adjustment to existing policy aimed at stimulating investment in specific regions, which can have meaningful effects on local economies.
reforms.source_quote: This provision was extended for a further year in October 1977.
